newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - S3 Inc shares dip.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - S3 Inc shares dip.

text.p: Shares of S3 Inc edged lower in after hours trading on Thursday on predictions that soft seasonal demand and significant pricing pressure would bring the company's second quarter revenues to $108 million, traders said.
Dealers said the personal computer operating systems supplier traded at 9-5/8, down slightly from 10 at the day's close.
S3 said current Wall Street revenue estimates ranged from $105 million to $121.
Also trading was Juno Lighting Inc, which dropped to 16-1/2 from a close of 17-3/16, after the company said its second quarter earnings per share were $0.29, unchanged against the year-ago period.
Gensym Corp and Integrated Silicon remained halted after releasing earnings-related news.
Gensym said it expected a second quarter loss of $0.20-$0.30 a share before a $0.20 restructuring charge, and Integrated Silicon forecast a third quarter loss of $0.25 to $0.29 a share.

ImmuLogic Pharmaceutical Corp also was halted after hours after it said that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had asked for more information on its Allervax product, causing a delay in clinical trials.

"There was a lot of trading during the day, but after the close there hasn't been much at all," a trader said in reference to a decline in the Dow Jones Industrial Average during regular hours trading.
The Dow Jones suffered a sharp drop late in the day, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to put curbs on program trading, before recovering to end down 36 points at 7654.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume fell to 1,600 from 21,000 the previous day, and session two volume fell to 4.0 million from 4.9 million.
